comparisons.notes: DTIUGUTAE oversized Rainbow frames. The store's own product data shows SKU B09NYLB67K (the Woot ASIN) and available=true. Free US shipping.

writeup: Woot has the DTIUGUTAE DG1001 oversized rainbow blue-light blocking glasses, ASIN B09NYLB67K and UPC 782890399890, for $5.99. Vita NutriUS lists the same DTIUGUTAE oversized Rainbow frames with that ASIN at $25.54, in stock with free US shipping, so this is about 76 percent below that price and saves roughly $20. The lightweight TR90 frames can have the lenses swapped for a prescription at an optical shop. Woot did not state a condition. Quantity is capped, with 3 or more left and a limit of 3 per customer.
